next_action.description: Start MPI-372 - make the PromptBox reachable while a mask tool is active. Read .agents/mpi-kanban/tasks/MPI-372/brief.md FIRST; it holds the user's complaint, the three candidate approaches and the trap that makes this a design job. DO NOT WRITE CODE BEFORE BRIEFING THE USER on which approach to take - nothing is decided. The trap: `prompt` is a rail tool, and entering it calls viewer.el.swapToPreview() while leaving it calls swapToCanvas(), so the canvas and the preview are different surfaces and 'just show both' is not a CSS change; resolving that coupling IS the task. Everything lives in js/components/Blocks/MpiGroupHistoryBlock/MpiGroupHistoryBlock.js - mountOptions(mode), the mpi-group-history-block--prompt-active class, _shouldShowPromptBox(), _hasPromptOps(), _mountPromptBoxIfNeeded() - plus MpiGroupHistoryBlock.css. Whatever is decided must work for every tool in the mask family, including Shapes (MPI-368) and Text (MPI-361 Phase B) when they land.

key_decisions: THE MASK STRIP IS ONE COMPONENT ON EVERY MASK TOOL. The user has now said this three times across sessions: brush, eraser, invert, clear and opacity are ONE component at the bottom of every mask tool, with the brush + eraser pair OPTIONAL and gated off where it makes no sense (Points now, probably Shapes). Do NOT re-ask this, and do NOT add a separate Paint tool - the user rejected that explicitly.
MpiMaskDetectRow exists because Points, Detect and (later) Text differ only in what they feed the graph, never in how a result is reviewed and committed. Shapes mounts MpiMaskStrip alone.
ONE toolKey for the whole family ('mask'). That is what makes settings survive a tool swap; splitting per-tool keys would break the user's stated requirement that settings persist.

AUTO PICKS UNION LAST. mask = (manual AND NOT subtract) U picks; auto = U picks. A pick is a deferred positive assertion, exactly like a brush stroke over an erased area, so an erase that predates it does not veto it. This is what makes the green preview equal what Add bakes. There are TWO twins of this math - MaskManager._recomposite() and MpiCanvasViewer._buildCompositeFromTemp() - and they must change together.
The colour split is still DISPLAY-ONLY. getURL() / getMaskDataURL() flatten the single unioned maskCanvas that every downstream consumer reads. Do not leak autoCanvas into an export path.

Rail tool modes are maskDetect / maskPoints, but the viewer only knows the canvas modes 'crop' and 'mask'. _viewerModeFor() in MpiGroupHistoryBlock bridges them; any new mask tool must be added to _isMaskTool().
The YOLO Detect tool STAYS - it is the fast one-click Face / Hair / Hand / Person shortcut. Points sits beside it, it does not replace it.

The Cue queue gate now covers MpiMaskDetectRow only, not the whole panel. Model radios and the Scope slider stay live while Cue is busy because neither runs anything. Deliberate, marked with a ponytail: comment.
